entries.title: Open-Rear Sloped Teacher Lectern
entries.description: One original fixed classroom teacher lectern, counted as one complete prop. A continuous thick three-sided cabinet shell and full chamber floor rise to a genuinely inclined writing desk. The whole sloped desktop has an integral full-width raised retaining lip at the teacher-facing rear edge. One separate thick inner shelf forms two genuinely open rear storage bays, with narrow full-length side clearances; a broad closed plinth provides the whole ground sole. Four complete editable closed meshes and four opaque constant untextured PBR materials, metres, native Z up, public presentation front -Y, teacher access +Y and horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. All numeric model geometry is newly authored. No old desk, counter, music stand, bookcase or instrument console geometry is imported, resized, recoloured or combined. entries.title: Scalloped-Cavity Mooncake Mould Paddle
entries.description: One original complete static Mid-Autumn Festival mooncake-mould-inspired wooden paddle. A thick square mould head has a genuinely recessed eight-scallop cavity, a complete thick floor and full interior walls. A separate raised eight-petal die relief rests on the whole finite cavity floor. A tapered fixed handle has a genuine through hanging aperture and a complete finite end-face joint to the head. Three complete editable closed meshes and three opaque constant untextured PBR wood tones. Metres, native Z up, cavity facing +Z, presentation front -Y and horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. The entire broad head underside is grounded, with real air beneath the raised handle. Every numeric model shape is newly authored; no old mooncake, cutting board, baking peel, bowl, relief, stamp, tray or imported geometry is copied, scaled, recoloured or combined. One complete prop and zero scenes. No mooncake food, dough, utensil set, text, logo, texture, person, motion or surrounding scene.
